data.name: Alrahman
data.gender_notes: Alrahman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root r-h-m, meaning mercy and compassion. In Islamic context, Al-Rahman is one of the names of Allah, the Supreme Creator. The name Alrahman carries the meaning “The Most Merciful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alrahman usually hope their child will grow to embody the most merciful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of Allah, evoking the essence of divine mercy and compassion.
data.etymology: Alrahman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Most Merciful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alrahman total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: الرحمن
in_arabic.meaning: الرحمن أسم الله الحسنى الّذي يُشير إلى رحمته الكَبرى و فضلِه عَلى العباد
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرحمن أسم الله الحسنى الّذي يُشير إلى رحمته الكَبرى و فضلِه عَلى العباد، و هو واحد من أسماء الله الحسنة، و يُذكَر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الطّور، الآية 1. و يُعتبر أسمًا مقدسًا في الإسلام، و يُستخدم لوصف الله تعالى في كُل أعماله الخيرة، و رحمته الكَبرى للبشر. و هو أحد أسماء الله التي يُعتقد أَنها تُظهر صفاته العليا و جماله.

in_urdu.name: الرحمن
in_urdu.meaning: الرحمن اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک نیک نام ہے جو اس کے رحمت اور فضل پر اشارہ کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: الرحمن اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک نیک نام ہے جو اس کے رحمت اور فضل پر اشارہ کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن کے سورہ طور میں مذکور ہے، جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ اپنی رحمت اور قدرت کا تعریفی بیان کرتا ہے۔ اس نام کا استعمال مسلمانوں میں بہت عام ہے، اور اسے اللہ تعالیٰ کے رحمت اور فضل کا بھی سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अल्रहमान
in_hindi.meaning: अल्रहमान भगवान का एक पवित्र नाम है जो उनकी कृपा और दया को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अल्रहमान भगवान का एक पवित्र नाम है जो उनकी कृपा और दया को दर्शाता है। यह नाम कुरान के सूरह तूर में उल्लिखित है, जहाँ भगवान अपनी कृपा और शक्ति का वर्णन करते हैं। इस नाम का उपयोग मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत आम है, और इसे भगवान की कृपा और दया का भी माना जाता है।

in_english.name: Alrahman
in_english.meaning: Alrahman is a beautiful name of Allah that signifies His mercy and beneficence
in_english.long_meaning: Alrahman is a beautiful name of Allah that signifies His mercy and beneficence. This name is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Tawr, where Allah describes His mercy and power. It is considered a sacred name in Islam, used to describe Allah's kindness and benevolence towards humanity. It is one of the names of Allah that is believed to reflect His attributes of greatness and beauty.

data.cultural_impact: Al-Rahman is an Arabic name used in Islamic tradition to refer to God as the All-Merciful and All-Compassionate Being. This name is part of the opening verse of Surah Al-Fatiha, the most frequently recited surah in Islam, making it a central part of Muslim daily prayers. The cultural significance of Al-Rahman stems from its role in reinforcing the idea of God's endless love, care, and mercy for His creations.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of Al-Rahman is rooted in the Islamic belief that God is the ultimate source of mercy and compassion. This belief is further emphasized by descriptions from Hadiths and Sunnahs, wherein Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) frequently offered prayers and supplications to Allah as Al-Rahman, seeking His mercy and forgiveness. In Islamic spirituality, relying on Al-Rahman's mercy and seeking refuge in His compassion is a central principle that helps Muslims navigate life's trials, hardships, and fears.
